lines: - **Episode Title:** INFILTRATION: Charlie Kirk Was Being Tracked For Years.
- **Source Used For Analysis:** YouTube video + cleaned transcript (yt-dlp-manual captions, lexicon + paragraph merge applied, music cues dropped)
- **Transcript Completeness Status:** Complete; minor transcription cleanup applied. Live-chat read-aloud section partially compressed but content preserved.
- **Existing Nodes Reused:** N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-41 (Governor Cox)

This episode centers on a host-constructed flight-tracking timeline alleging that two Egyptian-registered aircraft (tail numbers SUBTT and SUBND) repeatedly landed in U.S. cities in close temporal proximity to Turning Point USA (TPUSA), TPUSA Faith, and Charlie Kirk speaking events between 2022 and September 2025. The host supplements the flight data with referenced artifacts including a TPUSA UNL chapter Instagram launch post, a referenced internal TPUSA promotion email for Mikey McCoy, a referenced June 2025 article detailing fraud and embezzlement allegations against Sean Feucht, a referenced public statement by Bibi Netanyahu regarding outreach to Charlie Kirk, and a Borderline Bar and Grill 2018 shooting reference linking Rob McCoy to the site pastor's circle.

Secondary evidentiary material includes a documented N102DZ private jet movement from Scottsdale to Salt Lake City on the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination, read-aloud live-chat comments providing additional context (including a tail-number Google-search attribution claim), and a referenced Joel Osteen plumber news story used as comparative context. The host advances several broad framing claims (foreign-actor involvement, hostile takeover of TPUSA, Christian-Zionist infiltration) but the episode does not present artifacts directly supporting those framing premises; they are not inscribed as artifact-backed claims. The structural importance of the episode lies in (1) the first extensive display of the Egyptian-plane tracking claim and (2) the introduction of Sean Feucht, Rob McCoy, Mikey McCoy, Tyler Bowyer, Tucker Carlson, Andrew Kolvet, Bibi Netanyahu, Jack Hibbs, Joel Osteen, Village Crazy Lady (Melissa), and Joe Kent into the investigative record.
